identitySignals: Name matches: georgehills.com describes 'George Hills', a California third party administrator (TPA), matching 'George Hills Company, Inc.' in the agenda

Services match the contract: the website says the company provides claims administration, litigation management and subrogation services to public entities, matching OUSD's 'Claims Adjusting and Administrative Services Contract, Subrogation Agreement' with the General Counsel

Location NOT confirmed: the agenda says Rancho Cordova, CA, but the company's contact page gives corporate headquarters in Rocklin, CA (offices 'throughout California'); no Rancho Cordova office was found
research.notes: Web search budget was exhausted, so no registry (CA Secretary of State, SAM.gov) check was possible and the Rancho Cordova vs. Rocklin location discrepancy could not be resolved. Contact page lists HQ in Rocklin (PO Box 120, Rocklin, CA 95677) and a general phone, but these were left out because the location does not match the agenda and they could not be tied to the Rancho Cordova entity. Needs a human check or a re-run with search available.

profile.summary: George Hills is a third party administrator that provides claims administration, litigation management and subrogation recovery services to public entities and private insurance carriers in California. It says it has operated in California since 1954.
